name: Pis'ma Alisy
source:
What should you do if you get lost in your own illusions? What should you do if you cannot draw a line between reality and fiction? Just recently, the Sovyonok camp was so tangible that reality seemed like nothing more than a nightmare. Now reality is a cage, and the camp is the product of a sick imagination. Or is that just what the psychiatrist thinks? And where are these strange letters coming from?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=894379224]Steam[/url]]
